title: Qwen2 Technical Report
before: Open weights meant Western labs, with English-centric training data.
problem: Most of the world's users and much of its text are not English.
breakthrough: A full family from 0.5B to 72B with strong multilingual coverage, mostly Apache 2.0.
why: Qwen became the most downloaded and fine-tuned open family, and the base for a large share of derivative models.
